Mobs by zone

691 spawn entries from the live roster. Open a zone to inspect its form names, levels, Core, combat values and drops.

Mob rules at a glance

10 form bands · 220 named forms · 22 species.

TopicRule
LevelA spawn uses its species level for the zone; it does not scale to the player.
Form and CoreEach race has a named fixed-Core form for every ten-level band through 100; each card shows its form band. Levels above the cap reuse the latest form. Mobs have no equipment or passive tree; a Boss may use its own Core.
Health and manaHP uses the mob_HP curve plus per-level HP and Core Vit × K_VIT_HP. Mana uses its base, per-level gain and Core Int × K_INT_MP.
CombatThe shared engine derives DPS, Accuracy, Critical chance, Alignment, Armour, Evasion and dodge from Core, damage tag, body class and zone.
Elements and traitsNormal and Elite spawns inherit their race Element and resist only it. A Boss may set its own Element and resistance. Traits apply their named mechanic.
DropsZone band sets gear quality. Drop variants and subzone environment leans redistribute gear, herbs and junk. Elite and Boss add stone drops; normal humanoid spawns can drop potions. Only weapon-carrying species drop weapons.
Zone 1 · Eastgate — pinewood roadLv 1–10 · low band · fire · 60 spawns

Sides: Open Grassland: 1-3 pack · 10% Elite · a swarm of small bodies · Village Outskirts: 1-2 pack · 20% Elite · an even mix · Raider Camp: 1-1 pack · 30% Elite · heavy bodies
